newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Abidjan bourse closes firm, helped by motor sector.
newsitem.headline: Abidjan bourse closes firm, helped by motor sector.

text.p: The Abidjan Stock Exchange (BVA) rose for a sixth successive week, fuelled in part by companies in the motor industry, its market report showed on Friday.
The All-Share Index rose 2.23 percent to 392.96 points, taking the rise for the year to 9.83 percent.

The 12 VB blue-chip index, which lagged in early January, rose 1.84 percent to 267.66 points, after rising 2.68 percent the previous week and 4.22 percent the week before that. The rise for the year was 10.61 percent.
Cloth makers UNIWAX (+3,520 CFA francs to 66,040 CFA) led risers followed by vehicle sellers SARI (+2,440 to 26,240) and motor loan company SAFCA (+2,010 to 21,680).
ELF OIL-CI (+1,690 to 33,620) and rubber firm SOGB (+1,660 to 17,980) were the other main risers.
Tobacco company SITAB (-4,480 to 42,470) were the main fallers.
